terra.problem: The text says Ezekiel saw six men, not that he counted them.
Calling Ezekiel a priest is a fact from outside this passage and needs its own reference.
The line about four being a nice round number is flat and does not make sense as a joke.
The claim that twelve comes up a lot in the Bible is outside this passage and has no supporting references.
Saying the man came to write rather than sound an alarm assigns him a purpose the text does not give.
Groaning is not the whole description. The men are sighing and groaning over all the abominations committed in Jerusalem.
Starting at the sanctuary is not necessarily the opposite of working from the borders inward. The text does not describe the route that way.
